claim: The expression of patterning genes dynamically evolves and stochastically fluctuates during development of multicellular systems.

claim: Developmental patterning achieves a high degree of accuracy.

evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous work.

claim: Developmental patterning achieves a high degree of robustness.

evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous work.

claim: The two models (threshold-dependent and self-organized filtering) have been suggested to collaborate in some developmental patterning systems.
